title: Karachi Development Authority Sindh Amendment Act 1994

sections.shortTitle: Karachi Development Authority Sindh Amendment Act 1994
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XXIII OF 1994
KARACHI DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
(SINDH AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
ACT XXIII OF 1994
An Act further to amend the Karachi Development Authority Order, 1957
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 4th October, 1994]
No. PAS/Legis-B-7/94, dated
4-10-1994.--The Karachi Development Authority (Sindh Amendment) Bill, 1994
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 4th August, 1994 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 25th September, 1994 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh ;--
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Karachi Development Authority (Sindh Amendment) Act, 1994.
(2) It shall
come into force on and from 2nd May, 1994.

sections.shortTitle: Karachi Development Authority Sindh Amendment Act 1994
sections.description:
Amendment of Article 52-A of K.D.A. Order V of 1957

ACT XXIII OF 1994
KARACHI DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
(SINDH AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
ACT XXIII OF 1994
An Act further to amend the Karachi Development Authority Order, 1957
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 4th October, 1994]
No. PAS/Legis-B-7/94, dated
4-10-1994.--The Karachi Development Authority (Sindh Amendment) Bill, 1994
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 4th August, 1994 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 25th September, 1994 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh ;--
2. Amendment of Article 52-A of K.D.A. Order V of 1957.--In the
Karachi Development Authority Order, 1957, in Article 52-A, for clauses (2),
(3) and (4) and Explanation thereunder, the following shall be substituted:,
"(2) No
amenity plot reserved for the purpose mentioned in clause (1) shall be
converted to or utilized for any other purpose."
